feature: Billing - the real artifacts/portal '/billing' page (src/pages/billing.tsx), part of #1598. Covers this build's own scope: Receipts (GET /api/portal/invoices, Git #1237) and 'Manage payment in Stripe' (POST /api/portal/billing/customer-portal), wired via billingLive.ts, per Design/portal/design_handoff_full_site/docs/portal/billing-contract-pack.md and the landed Billing.dc.html export. The landed design deliberately does NOT surface a live plan-state section (subscriptionsLive.ts / GET /portal/billing/subscriptions, Git #1611) on this page - its own logic states no tenant holds a monthly monitoring subscription today, so there is nothing real to show as a current plan; that endpoint stays real and unwired here, matching the design as shipped. Monitoring-plan tier cards are the design's own labeled illustration ('Illustrative, not your account'), not tenant data - not covered by apiTests.
notes: #3647 (2026-09-11): the 'Manage payment in Stripe' button is now also gated client-side on can("customer","billing.manage") - a presentation hint only, mirroring UserMenu.tsx's existing showBilling pattern. The real gate remains server-side (AUTH-GATE-2 below asks the identical customer:billing.manage, #3465); every holder of billing.view also holds billing.manage today so this hides nothing yet, and becomes real the moment a customer role is granted view without manage - which is exactly what #3629's new Billing role (see test-manifests/portal/team-role-assignment.json) is for. Not independently asserted by a new apiTest here since it is a pure client-side render condition with no portal login page to drive it against (see the existing uiSteps limitation below) - the server-side boundary it mirrors is already covered by AUTH-GATE-2.

WHAT THIS COVERS: both real reads/actions this page wires - GET /api/portal/invoices (Receipts) and POST /api/portal/billing/customer-portal (Manage payment in Stripe) - are auth-gated as documented, and a logged-in customer gets the real payload shape billingLive.ts consumes.

WHAT THIS DOES NOT COVER, AND WHY (no portal login page yet): artifacts/portal has no login page today (#1648) - App.tsx's RequireAuth renders an honest 'Sign in required' panel for an unauthenticated visitor, the same structural gap test-manifests/portal/account-security-data-rights.json (#2996) and customer-home-overview.json (#2921) already document. The uiSteps below only assert what is honestly reachable today. apiTests exercise the full real backend directly with a real bearer token. Once a portal login page exists, extend this manifest with a real login block + goto '/billing' + assert on real rendered data-testids (billing-source / billing-manage-payment / billing-receipt-row / billing-download-<id> are already on the page) - no code change needed on the page side.

GET /api/portal/billing/customer-portal IS A POST that opens a real Stripe session - not exercised end-to-end here (it would open a live external redirect target for whichever account authenticates); the auth-gate (401 unauthenticated) is asserted, matching the same real-write caution account-security-data-rights.json documents for its own deletion-request POST.
ENV VARS required: DEPLOY_URL, TEST_PORTAL_EMAIL / TEST_PORTAL_PASSWORD (the same designated testbed portal account other artifacts/portal manifests use).

NOT YET RUN via shaneapp://runTest as of this build (2026-09-06, session for #2998): BuildConsole's local instance resolves test-manifests/ and UI routes against the dev-server checkout, which does not yet have this page/route merged/deployed (this branch is not yet picked up). Same structural gap #2921's and #2996's own manifests document for their uiSteps run. Verified instead by: a real `tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit` pass (0 errors) and a real `vite build` (succeeds) against artifacts/portal with this page + route added, plus direct reading of portal-billing.ts confirming the shapes billingWire.ts/billingLive.ts assert against. Re-run this manifest via shaneapp://runTest once the dev-server merge/restart cycle has picked up this branch.

apiTests.name: AUTH-GATE-1 - GET /api/portal/invoices with no Authorization header returns 401 (requireAuth)
AUTH-GATE-2 - POST /api/portal/billing/customer-portal with no Authorization header returns 401 (requireAuth)
SETUP - log in as the designated testbed portal account to obtain a real client bearer; extract it as {{authToken}}
INVOICES - an authenticated GET /api/portal/invoices returns a real array (possibly empty), never a fixture substitution

uiSteps.name: Unauthenticated visit: the shell route mounts and RequireAuth's honest sign-in-required panel renders (no portal login page exists yet - see notes)
